content: Ingiese Yutai kun danlase yan haochu wo? Hetoune giese yande gou wo?
Go fanmiende wine. Xien Hudai kielienyi hhelade ogiwo.
Niezhanla xianxin ulie giese matugiene? Hhela kekao wise Hudaye kekao uwonu?
Kenjin pusho! Kunla man ghudan kieliese Huda ghudan ulie kieliene. Jinwun jiere jilasan mutun,
Matanyi gou wiku Hudai gounii khizheghase matan matui kieliene? Huda matanyi faise gundan uwonu? Bi kunni jiodughala kieliezho.
Kenjin pusho! Qinse Huda matugie duyani panjine?
Bi ghudan kieliedene Hudai zhennii qinchushighazhi hhei kuaise mii yangiezhi zuiren mutun panjine?
Qinse matan huaini gieyema, gouni irene giezhi yale ulie kieliene? Niezhanla bijien ingiezhi kieliezho giezhi zhazho. Ene kunlai indan panjikuni wo.
Gou Kun Nieda Uwo
Ingiese bijien Yutai kun niman kunlase hen onu? Kenjin pusho! Kunla man zui dunda wo, Yutai kun niman kun man niekielien wo giezhi bijien kieliezhi daozho.
Jinwun jiere jilasan mutun,

content.text: Kunla man xiemachalazhi yama oronde uwo.
Gounii giechen kun uwo, nieliuzhe uwo."

content: Guijinshi guijintu kunlade kieliesei matan mejiene. Ingiedene soyuji kunlai amanni menjighazhi qienxiani kunlai man Hudai panjikude ireghane.
Guijinni zunjizhi giedene Hudai melie gounide sanasan kun nieda uwo. Guijinni tungo giezhi zuini mejiene.
Xianxin Giekughala Gounide Sanane
Ede guijinse chugo Hudai gundanni khizhezho. Enende guijinshu, xienzhishu jiere ganzhen beizho.
Hheshijiu Ersa Mexihai xianxin giesan jien kunlade olusan Hudai gundanni wo. Yan kunliuzhe niekielien wo.
Jien kunla zui fanjidene Hudai famade dai dazhoma,
Ersa Mexihai shuikui tungo giezhi Hudai nenjienghala belien gouni wo giezho.
Huda Ersai kunni oronde fugughazhi shuiku gholughawo. Hhei xianxin giesan kunlai zuini mienliene. Ingiezhi Huda gundanne uzheghawo. Eqighandei Huda kunla fanjisan zuini rennai giezhi ese gonjizho.
Edeku shihoude ingiezhi Huda goyaneshi gundan bikui, pse Ersai xianxin giesan kunlai gounii uzheghazho.
Ingiese matan yanni kuaine? Yama kuaikui uwo. Yan banfaghala wo? Gieku banfaghala onu? Pusho! Xianxin gieku banfaghala wo.
Bijien uzhese kunni gounide sanakushi guijinni zunjizhi giekughala pusho, xianxin giekughala wo.
Hudashi zinie Yutai kunlai Huda onu? Niman kunlai Huda pushonu? Enbene, hheshi niman kunlai Hudaye enbene.
Hudashi nie wo. Hetoune giesanlai xianxin giekughala gounide sanane, hetoune uye giesanlaiye xianxin giekughala gounide sanane.
Ingiese matan xianxin giekughala guijinni bendazhou? Kenjin uye! Khareidene guijinni khiduzheghazho.
